events.description: CIA information report disseminated on the timeframe for Bin Ladin's planned hijack operation in the United States.
Key operatives of the hijack plot reportedly arrested at a small airport near Washington, D.C. or New York; the operation may have run into trouble.
Date by which Usama bin Ladin hoped to complete the hijack operation in the US ('circa 10 January 1998' as OCR'd; probably 1999).
CIA information report distributed on the timeframe for completion of a Bin Ladin hijacking operation in the United States.
Target date (circa 10 January 1998, as printed) by which Bin Ladin hoped to complete the hijack operation in the United States.
Report suggests the operation may have run into trouble because key operatives had been arrested at a small airport near Washington, D.C. or New York.

key_claims: Usama bin Ladin hoped to complete a hijack operation in the United States by about 10 January.
The operation may have run into trouble because key operatives had reportedly been arrested at a small airport near Washington, D.C. or New York.
The report is unevaluated information with extensive redactions, so sourcing and details are excised.
